instruction: Candid wide-angle photograph from a high angle of an indoor studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing forward with her left hand on her hip. On the right, the man in the black cap and dark polo shirt (R1) stands facing left, extending his right arm to touch her shoulder. Overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the room.
